title: "Practical 1 · Getting started"

Work through the exercises in RStudio. Solutions are shared after the session.

```{r}
#| include: false
patients <- read.csv("../../data/patients.csv")
```

## Exercise 1 · Calculations

::: {.callout-note .exercise}
## Exercise 1
Calculate the mean of the numbers 120, 135, 128 and 142.
:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="instructor"}
::: {.solution}
```{r}
mean(c(120, 135, 128, 142))
```
:::
:::

## Exercise 2 · Import the data

::: {.callout-note .exercise}
## Exercise 2
Import `patients.csv` into an object called `patients`. How many rows and columns does it have?
:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="instructor"}
::: {.solution}
```{r}
dim(patients)
```

There are `r nrow(patients)` patients and `r ncol(patients)` variables.
:::
:::

## Exercise 3 · First look

::: {.callout-note .exercise}
## Exercise 3
What is the average age of the patients? How many received the **New** treatment?
:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="instructor"}
::: {.solution}
```{r}
mean(patients$age)
table(patients$treatment)
```
:::
:::
